title: cargo-crap delta report (v2)
description: Wire format produced by `cargo crap --format json --baseline FILE`. v2 adds the `moved` status and the optional `previous_file` field for entries that were paired by name across files (spec 13).

entries.description: Per-function entries from the current run, each annotated with its delta against the baseline.

removed.description: Functions present in the baseline but absent from the current run.

diagnostics.description: Optional source/LCOV scope diagnostics for the current run (spec 24); absent for complexity-only runs.

duplicates.description: Candidate duplicate function pairs, ordered by descending score. Present only on `--duplicates` runs; absent (not empty) otherwise, so "not asked" stays distinguishable from "asked, found nothing".

duplicate_groups.description: The duplicate pairs grouped into functions that each resemble every other member, ordered by descending score, then by members. A pair whose functions share no larger group is a group of two, so every pair in `duplicates` lies inside one group. Present only on `--duplicates` runs, like `duplicates`. When the baseline recorded its duplicates, each group carries its `status` against them.

untriaged_groups.description: How many duplicate groups the triage budget (`max-requests`) left unasked, so they carry no `triage`. Only new and grown groups are asked on a delta run, so an unchanged group has no `triage` and is never counted. Present only when the budget left one of the asked groups unasked: absent means every asked group got a verdict request, or triage did not run.

try_weight.description: The weight each `?` operator added to cyclomatic complexity when the current run's entries were scored (`try-weight` in `.cargo-crap.toml`). Present only when it is not the default 1.0; absent means 1.0.

uncovered.description: Maximal runs of instrumented-but-never-hit lines inside the function's span, from the current run. Omitted when empty or when the file had no coverage data at all.

signals.description: Structural maintainability signals (spec 43). Omitted unless signals are enabled.

baseline_signals.description: The paired baseline function's signals (spec 43). Omitted for new functions and baselines recorded without signals.

reasons.description: What got harder to maintain since the baseline, and where (spec 43). Omitted when empty.

baseline_crap.description: CRAP score from the baseline run; null when this function is new.

delta.description: current.crap - baseline_crap; null when this function is new.

status.description: Change category relative to the baseline. `moved` is reported when a function was paired across files by name (second-pass matcher) AND its score did not change beyond the epsilon. Score-changed moves use `regressed` / `improved` instead, with `previous_file` set.

previous_file.description: Baseline location when this entry was paired across files. Omitted when the entry was matched on the exact (file, function) pair (the common case) or is genuinely new.

Signals.description: Structural maintainability signals (spec 43). Present only when `[signals] enabled = true`.

nesting.description: Deepest number of nested bodies (`if`, `match`, loops, `let ... else`, closures, `async` blocks).

lines.description: The function's span in lines, signature to closing brace.

bumps.description: Top-level statements whose own nesting reaches 2.

bool_ops.description: Most `&&` / `||` operators in one `if` / `while` condition or match guard.

Reason.description: One way a function got harder to maintain since the baseline (spec 43).

signal.description: The signal that rose, or `crap` for a regressed CRAP score.

value.description: The current value: an integer for signals, the score for `crap`.

baseline.description: The paired baseline value. Omitted for a new function.

limit.description: The configured limit a new function exceeded.

start.description: 1-indexed first uncovered line of the range (inclusive).

end.description: 1-indexed last uncovered line of the range (inclusive).

baseline_crap.description: CRAP score the function had in the baseline.

ScopeDiagnostics.description: Source/LCOV scope overlap (spec 24). Large stray sets mean the analyzed tree and the coverage run describe different scopes.

analyzed_files.description: Distinct source files that produced at least one analyzed function.

lcov_files.description: Distinct SF records in the LCOV report.

matched_files.description: Files present on both sides after path matching.

source_only.description: Analyzed files with no LCOV match.

lcov_only.description: LCOV SF files matched by no analyzed file.

StrayFiles.description: One side's stray files: the true count plus at most 10 sorted example paths.

count.description: True number of stray files on this side (not capped).
